description: This file defines a React functional component for the 'Sign Out' view in a web application, handling user sign-out interactions, including signing out other sessions, managing sessions, and workspace sign-out options. It also conditionally renders a data clearance view if no account is present.

methods.name: SignOutView
methods.description: React component displaying sign out options including signing out other sessions, managing sessions, and workspace sign-out, with a close link to sign out all sessions.

methods.name: SignOutWrapper
methods.description: Higher-order component that conditionally renders the SignOutView or ClearSessionDataView based on the presence of a user account.
